title: Chapter 1: On the Road
sub: Vocabulary for trips, transit, and new cities.

cards.def: A short stop between legs of a journey.
examples: We have a three-hour layover in Dubai.
During the layover, we ate at the airport food court.
Choose a flight with a short layover if you're travelling with kids.
My layover in Singapore was long enough to visit the city.
The village had a picturesque harbor lined with fishing boats.
Munnar's tea gardens are truly picturesque.
We stayed in a picturesque cottage by the lake.
The picturesque old town is full of colourful houses.

cards.def: Quiet and private; away from other people.
examples: They found a secluded beach with no one else in sight.
The resort is secluded, with no shops nearby.
We found a secluded spot in the park for our picnic.
He bought a secluded farmhouse to escape city noise.

cards.def: A short trip taken for pleasure, often as part of a longer visit.
examples: The hotel offers a day excursion to the nearby waterfalls.
The school organised an excursion to the science museum.
Our tour included an excursion to an old fort.
We booked a boat excursion to see the dolphins.
